description: This file defines the JmsQueueListener class, which implements a JMS queue message listener for Apache OFBiz. It manages connection setup, message listening, and cleanup for a JMS queue.

classes.name: JmsQueueListener
classes.description: A JMS Queue (P2P) message listener that manages connection, message reception, and cleanup for a specific queue.

methods.name: JmsQueueListener
methods.description: Constructor initializing the listener with connection parameters.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the JMS session and connection, throwing a GenericServiceException on failure.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Initializes the JMS connection, session, and queue receiver, setting up message listening and exception handling.
